flags.detail: The Bruins played the Hurricanes on 2026-10-27, and the morning_brew incorrectly claims this game happened on 'Tuesday night' (2026-10-28) and fails to provide a proper recap of the actual game played on the 27th.
The Bruins played the Hurricanes on 2026-10-27, but the morning_brew fails to recap that game, instead focusing on the upcoming game against the Blues.
The output incorrectly places the Bruins' game against the Hurricanes at the Garden: 'Tuesday night at the Garden was a total disastah.'
